segments.he: כּוּתָּח הַבַּבְלִי וְכׇל מִינֵי כּוּתָּח אָסוּר לִמְכּוֹר שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם קוֹדֶם הַפֶּסַח.
segments.en: With regard to «Babylonian kutaḥ,» a spice that contains leavened bread crumbs, and «all kinds of kutaḥ, it is prohibited to sell» it to a gentile «thirty days before Passover.» Because kutaḥ is used exclusively as a spice, it lasts longer than other foods.
